name: Horrifique Chtonien
description: Éveillé des profondeurs de la croûte planétaire, Horrifique Chtonien est une force de la nature faite d'obsidienne et de magma refroidi. Son pas massive fait trembler le sol, annonçant l'éveil des anciens dieux de la terre.

subject.archetype: Horrifique Chtonien - Titanesque Prophet of Void

loadout.armor_outfit: Natural carapace of cooled obsidian plates and volcanic rock fused to flesh, tectonic armor sections with glowing magma seams, asymmetrical protective plates resembling fractured earth crust, jagged mineral protrusions along spine and shoulders, cracked volcanic skin revealing pulsing molten core beneath
loadout.arsenal: Dimensional pressure field emanating from palms, shadow tentacles summoned from void rifts, ancient runes of cosmic dissolution carved into flesh, reality-warping gravitational forces controlled through gesture

attitude.behavior: Standing firm with both massive clawed hands thrust forward in devastating push motion, immense body coiled with primordial power, legs planted wide in stance of cosmic inevitability, dimensional force wall expanding outward from palms creating visible distortion barrier
attitude.emotion: Cold cosmic malevolence radiating despair, hollow prophetic certainty of universal ending, ancient maleficence devoid of mercy, presence inducing existential terror and hopelessness in all who witness

palette_names.name: Magma Orange-Red
palette_names.role: glowing seams, energy manifestations, internal heat

scenography.setting: Torn dimensional battlefield with ground splitting in massive fissures, exposed magma rivers from planetary core, enormous shadow tentacles erupting from void rifts below, sky warped with impossible geometry and eldritch patterns, ancient dissolution runes blazing on every fractured surface, reality thinning and fragmenting at edges
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: thick_dark_volcanic_smoke, dimensional_energy_discharge, reality_distortion_waves, crumbling_ground_particles, ancient_prophetic_runes_flickering, abyssal_light_from_fissures, oppressive_void_presence_pervading
